This #FlashbackFriday, we’re looking back to August and our incredible Olympic Pathways Camp, run in collaboration with the US Sailing Team!

More than 30 Olympic hopeful sailors from across the country joined us at one of the LA2028 Olympic sailing venues in San Pedro, CA for three days dedicated to learning, trying new boats, meeting other sailors, and exploring what a future Olympic campaign could look like.

On the water, sailors had the opportunity to try four current Olympic classes: the 470, 49er, 49erFX, and Nacra17 with current Olympic campaigners and expert coaches on hand.

Participants also heard presentations about what it truly takes to build and run an Olympic campaign and most importantly, learned about the resources and support available through Oakcliff and the USST as they take their next steps.

And, of course, no camp is complete without pizza! Our post-sailing social gave sailors a chance to connect with other athletes from around the country, make new friends, talk about potential partnerships, and(hopefully😄) start planning their own paths toward the 2032 Olympic Games.

One of the biggest goals of Oakcliff’s High Performance Program is to help make the Olympic pathway more accessible and give the next generation of American sailors the knowledge, opportunities, and connections they need to take that next step.

Interested in building your own path toward the Olympic Games? We’re here to help.

Email highperformance@oakcliffsailing.org to get started!

We are excited to be joining US Sailing to bring the Olympic Pathways Camps back for 2027! Together we are creating opportunities around the US for aspiring Olympic sailors to try Olympic-class boats and learn what it takes to pursue an Olympic campaign. We are starting with a shorter camp January 8-10 in Miami and will be running a more intensive 10-day fully immersive Olympic Campaign bootcamp here in Oyster Bay June 5-15!

Applications for the January Miami Camp are here: https://secure.oakcliffsailing.org/forms/olypathwayscamp 

Information on our June camp and full high performance program can be found here: https://www.oakcliffsailing.org/high-performance-acorn-program/
